comparison: Both evaluate the major findings (C4-C8). OpenEval marks all as SUPPORTED based on extensive experimental data. Perfect overlap on C56-C58 (cholesterol biosynthesis). Both mark SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes the behavioral contribution claim (C58) is correlative. Peer review does not specifically comment but accepts as part of 'extensive and informative' transcriptome analysis.

Perfect overlap on C106-C108 (pancreatic mechanisms). OpenEval marks UNCERTAIN, noting speculative mechanisms without direct experimental support. Peer review marks SUPPORTED, accepting pancreatic findings as part of tissue-specific pattern without challenging the proposed mechanisms.
